title.narrative: NESA Center Libya Task Force 01-23

description.narrative: The Libya Task Force, organized by the Near East South Asia Center for Strategic Studies (NESA) in partnership with USAFRICOM. This program is designed to continue a conversation with Libyan CMED participants about the pressing issues in today's Libya; priorities that need to be addressed; and prospects for the immediate and mid-term future. The basic questions to be examined: What do Libyans want Libya to be and what are the next steps moving ahead? The Libyan only intense RT discussion on 19 Feb follows 2 days (20-24 hrs) of broader security discussions. The meetings are held under Chatham House Rule, by-name invitation only.

The basic question to be examined: What do these countries want their nations to be and what are the next steps moving ahead? The meeting will be held under Chatham House Rule, by-name CMED invitation only.
